newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada jobless claims rise 0.4 pct in April.
newsitem.headline: Canada jobless claims rise 0.4 pct in April.

text.p: The number of Canadians who applied for employment insurance benefits in April rose 0.4 percent in April from March, Statistics Canada said on Tuesday.
Claims rose to 229,000 in April from 228,000 in March according to seasonally adjusted data, the federal agency said.
The number of Canadians who received regular employment insurance benefits was about 569,000 in April, down 3.7 percent from March, the agency said.
The level of regular benefit payments declined for the fourth consecutive month to C$744 million in April, a drop of 0.4 percent seasonally adjusted.
